note: Patient complains of burning sensation while passing urine for 4 days. No fever. Diagnosed with urinary tract infection. Started nitrofurantoin 100 mg twice daily for 5 days. Review in 1 week with urine culture report.

32 year old female presents with itchy red rash on both forearms since yesterday. Denies breathing difficulty. Impression is contact dermatitis. Prescribed cetirizine 10 mg once daily at night and calamine lotion. Follow up if rash spreads.
Known diabetic on metformin 500 mg twice daily. Fasting sugar 182 mg/dl today. Diabetes poorly controlled. Increase metformin to 1000 mg twice daily. Repeat HbA1c after 3 months.

Child brought with sore throat and difficulty swallowing for 2 days. Temperature 101 F. Tonsils enlarged with exudate. Suspected streptococcal tonsillitis. Amoxicillin 250 mg three times daily for 10 days. Paracetamol 250 mg as needed for fever. Revisit after course completion.

Patient reports lower back pain after lifting heavy boxes. No numbness or weakness in legs. Likely mechanical back strain. Ibuprofen 400 mg twice daily after food for 5 days. Advised physiotherapy. Return if pain persists beyond 2 weeks.

Complains of throbbing headache on one side with sensitivity to light. Similar episodes monthly. Diagnosis migraine without aura. Started sumatriptan 50 mg at onset of attack. Maintain a headache diary and review in 4 weeks.

Elderly male with swelling of both ankles and breathlessness on climbing stairs. Blood pressure 160/100. Assessment: hypertensive heart disease with fluid overload. Furosemide 40 mg once daily in the morning. Amlodipine 5 mg once daily. Monitor weight daily and follow-up in 10 days.

Patient has loose stools 6 times since morning with abdominal cramps. Denies blood in stool. Likely acute gastroenteritis. Oral rehydration solution after every stool. Ondansetron 4 mg if vomiting. Come back immediately if unable to drink fluids.

Asthmatic patient with wheezing and night cough for 1 week. No chest pain. Acute exacerbation of asthma. Salbutamol inhaler 2 puffs every 6 hours. Prednisolone 2.5 mg tablets, 4 tablets daily for 5 days. Review in 1 week to assess inhaler technique.

Young man with redness and watering of the right eye. Vision normal. Probable bacterial conjunctivitis. Moxifloxacin eye drops one drop four times a day for 7 days. Avoid touching eyes. Follow up in 5 days if not better.

Chief Complaint: redness and watering of the right eye

note: Patient complains of fatigue and weight gain over 3 months. TSH elevated at 9.8. Diagnosed with hypothyroidism. Levothyroxine 50 mcg once daily on empty stomach. Recheck TSH after 6 weeks.
Woman with burning pain in upper abdomen after meals. No vomiting. Impression gastritis. Pantoprazole 40 mg before breakfast for 4 weeks. Avoid spicy food and NSAIDs. Review after 1 month.

Patient presents with high grade fever with chills for 3 days and body ache. Platelet count 1.2 lakh. Suspected dengue fever. Paracetamol 650 mg three times daily. Avoid ibuprofen. Plenty of oral fluids. Repeat platelet count tomorrow.
Follow-up visit for hypertension. Patient is asymptomatic. Blood pressure 128/82 on telmisartan 40 mg once daily. Blood pressure well controlled. Continue same medication. Next visit in 3 months.

Patient complains of pain and swelling in the right knee after a fall. Able to bear weight. X-ray shows no fracture. Diagnosis knee sprain. Diclofenac gel to apply three times a day. Rest, ice and elevation. Review after 10 days.

Chief Complaint: pain and swelling in the right knee

note: Patient reports palpitations and anxiety for two weeks. ECG normal. No chest pain or fainting. Likely anxiety related palpitations. Propranolol 10 mg twice daily as needed. Referred to counselling. Follow up in 2 weeks.

Toddler with ear pain and pulling at left ear since last night. Fever 100.4 F. Left eardrum bulging. Acute otitis media. Amoxicillin 200 mg twice daily for 7 days. Ibuprofen syrup 5 ml for pain. Review in 3 days.

Patient complains of frequent urination and excessive thirst. Random blood sugar 310 mg/dl. New onset type 2 diabetes mellitus. Started metformin 500 mg once daily with dinner. Diet counselling given. Review with fasting sugar in 2 weeks.

Follow-up Plan: Review with fasting sugar in 2 weeks

note: Patient has dry cough for 3 weeks after starting enalapril. Lungs clear. No fever. ACE inhibitor induced cough. Stop enalapril. Switch to losartan 50 mg once daily. Follow up in 4 weeks.

Patient complains of heel pain worst with first steps in the morning. Tenderness at heel. Plantar fasciitis. Stretching exercises and soft footwear advised. Naproxen 250 mg twice daily for 1 week. Review in 6 weeks.
